name: hyphen-pairs-share-run
what: Two pairs that would share a run, both joinable: sun-/set-/ter in the witness, sunset and setter in the reading. The left pair is joined (1) and takes 'set'; 'ter' stays a word of its own. Witness words sunset ter = 2; found sunset; missing 1; share 50.0. Reading words sunset setter = 2; 'setter' unconfirmed.
